acquisition_method: Data analysis was conducted using Spectronaut software (version 18.5.231110.55695) in directDIA mode.
instrument: The peptide mixtures were analyzed using an Exploris 480 MS.
labeling: inferred: No isobaric labels, TMT, iTRAQ, or SILAC were mentioned in the proteomics section; only 'directDIA mode' and standard LC-MS/MS analysis are described.
ptm: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine, oxidation of methionine, acetylation of protein N-termini
Carbamidomethylation of cysteine was set as a fixed modification, while oxidation of methionine and acetylation of protein N-termini were set as variable modifications.
